# Globlazer M-0017804 — 78-inch Heavy Duty Cat Tree

- Source page: https://www.globlazer.com/open/4bf81c302bcb86d0.html
- Open-design index: https://www.globlazer.com/open/
- Model number: M-0017804-01
- Original stated height: 195.9 cm (78 inches)
- Retrieved: 2026-10-16
- Access: free public download; no account sign-in was required

The scene prefab was converted from the published Deskat design data. The source
design contains 63 authored components, including two baseboards, multiple levels,
32 pillars, four hammocks, two cat condos, two raised trays, and five hanging toys.

Globlazer describes selected Open Design Initiative files as available for
non-commercial study and remix with attribution/share-alike conditions. Verify the
current source-page terms before commercial redistribution. Attribution is retained
here and in the Unity hierarchy.

Unity presentation materials were mapped to the project's existing warm oak, warm
cream, rope, sage, and terracotta palette so the asset fits CatGameRoom without
changing the source design's multi-level structure.
